title: See Me and Believe Me: Causality and Intersectionality in Testimonial Injustice in Healthcare
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its findings focus on the causal relationships between demographic features (race, gender, and age) and testimonial injustice in healthcare, showing that race is the strongest contributor, followed by gender, and then age. It also highlights the importance of intersectionality in understanding these biases.
